title: The Advanced Depositor
description: Easy chest depositor like Hypixel does it!
body:
![Item Deposited](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07fb8990af70e9603eec0af16222283ed53e70b4.png)
TAD attempts to recreate the item deposit function from Hypixel Bedwars. By crouching, you can add whatever item you are currently holding into a chest. Configuration options like enabling/disabling tools (damageable items) and feedback (sounds and particles) also exist for player convenience.
